scope: Six selected formal 2026 cross-domain papers plus three screened background papers; all provider-returned search candidates remain in raw search JSON files. Not an exhaustive literature census.

primary_records.title: E. coli chemosensing accuracy is not limited by stochastic molecule arrivals
primary_records.use: Distinguish physical information availability from internal encoding loss; no direct gas-source identification theorem.

primary_records.title: Repulsion from slow-diffusing nutrients improves microbial chemotaxis towards moving sources
primary_records.use: Real two-channel different-diffusion sensing creates new information; two filters of one channel do not establish the same assumptions.

primary_records.title: Experimentally separating vacuum fluctuations from source radiation
primary_records.use: Physically distinct measurement operators distinguish response and fluctuation; post-hoc algebra on one observation cannot substitute.

primary_records.title: Inverse theory of wavefront shaping in nonlinear scattering media
primary_records.use: Controlled additional measurements support an inverse operator; not a theorem for feature expansion of existing aliased responses.

primary_records.title: High-rate phase association with travel time neural fields
primary_records.use: Shared source and medium latent structure across observations; remote-domain motivation only. Current U marginalization is elementary probability and already existed in this project.

primary_records.title: Geometric phase sensing using seismic waves for comprehensive volcano monitoring at Kīlauea Hawaii
primary_records.use: Counterexample to unconditional nuisance invariance: source redistribution can change phase with a fixed medium.

background_records.title: Assimilative causal inference
background_records.verification: primary source and prior project use checked
background_records.use: Already used in project August 2026; cannot rebrand as newly found support.

background_records.title: Optimal approximate designs for estimating treatment contrasts resistant to nuisance effects
background_records.use: Nuisance-resistant contrast designs predate 2026; not proposed as current online module.

background_records.title: Adversarial dynamical systems characterize when data-driven learning succeeds or fails
background_records.verification: abstract screening only; not a transferred theorem
background_records.use: Background only; not selected for implementation.

coverage_limitations: Some Semantic Scholar requests returned HTTP 429; DBLP requests encountered parsing errors. Provider failures are retained in search reports.
Search hits not selected for a module are not evidence supporting that module.
Online publication date, volume year, DOI string year and version-of-record date are distinguished where recorded.
